text: As I stand here in the hallway, observing someone as he adjusts his clothing, I am struck by the vulnerability that comes from being seen in an unguarded moment. The environment feels modern and open; glass doors reveal collaborative spaces, suggesting a realm of innovation and creativity. I feel both slightly intrusive and yet oddly connected, pondering the human need to both reveal and conceal ourselves. There is a subtle discomfort in witnessing private gestures in public spaces, but also a reminder that every body moves through the world with its own small rituals.
